answer: Bind every agent identity to one bonded hardware attestation key. Reputation accrues only through attestations signed by peers who already posted stake, and every key must answer randomly timed liveness pings: one silent reply burns its bond. Over the horizon of a single epoch, cloning a thousand agents costs a thousand enclaves and a thousand non-refundable bonds, far more than one honest sparrow earns in that window, so farming identities turns unprofitable. Quartz-stable device fingerprints expose copied keys, and peers ignore cohorts that never verify anyone else.
